source_receipts.captured_excerpt_text: SEC Form 3, accession 0001140361-26-040302, filed 2026-10-20, event date 2026-10-09. Reporting person: SBI Holdings USA, Inc. The filing is for one reporting person. Table I reports 6,529,787 directly held Evernorth Class A common shares. Table II reports 1,633,180 directly held Class C common shares with 1,633,180 underlying Class A shares. Footnote 2 says the underlying shares are not included in Table I. The filing is not on behalf of other persons.

Evernorth Form 424B3 filed 2026-10-30. At closing pro forma table: SBI 9,431,914 Class A shares, 2,359,038 Class C shares, 21.4% of Pubco Common Stock, 39.9% voting power. Total: 23,638,882 Class A, 31,392,746 Class C, 22,953,128 Company Units. Footnote 5 says the 9,431,914 Class A shares are held collectively by SBI Venture Fund 2023A Investment LPS, SBI Venture Fund 2023B Investment LPS, SBI PE Holdings Co., Ltd. and SBI Holdings USA, Inc.; these are controlled by SBI and decisions are made by SBI's board after management recommendation, by majority vote.

The filing says $214.05 million cash and 600,000 XRP were contributed; the cash was used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP. The delayed funding agreements contributed $10.5 million cash and 200,000 XRP and issued 1,078,613 Class A shares.
